trans.sense: artificial logical language based on Loglan

examples.text: To ensure Lojban remains stable while people learn it, the language definition is being closely controlled; the grammar and core vocabulary have already been baselined (frozen) for several years.
examples.ref: 2025 October 14 (last accessed), “Chapter 1. Questions and Answers on Lojban”, in lojban.org:

glosses: An artificial language created by Logical Language Group designed to be logical, based on the earlier Loglan.
